description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveSubject class, testing its behavior, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and construction constraints.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveSubject class, verifying behavior, immutability, JSON serialization, and input validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for RetrieveSubject.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Checks that an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Verifies that null label input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubjectId
